name: EMT grounding regression comparison
notes: Same fixed 36-question development cohort. Existing question IDs, texts, query frames and separate rubrics are unchanged.
All runs use human-labeled tracks, not detector predictions. This is not held-out or fine-tuned model accuracy.
The revision changes identity views, grounding instructions and sampling settings; differences do not isolate one causal effect.
Historical review labels are AI-assisted with student validation pending. New outputs require fresh content review, including previous passes.
The revised run paths are planned and do not exist until successful full reruns. No new review bindings are supplied in advance; unreviewed answers cannot receive a pass fraction.
Raw images and run folders remain local. Retrieval remains unscored without a separate answer key.
